category: evidence-backed Search and AI discoverability operations
productThesis: Goose helps a website owner choose a small number of evidence-backed discoverability interventions, verify the exact deployment, measure provider-native Search and AI outcomes, and decide what to keep, revise or stop.
northStar: Real sites completing a reviewed loop from goal and demand through observed state, chosen intervention, exact verified deployment and provider-native Search or AI evidence to an explicit keep, revise, continue, revert or retire decision.
currentBottleneck: No completed credible real-site chain yet exists from recommendation through exact deployed change and provider-native outcome to a reviewed decision.

proofFirstMilestone.goal: Complete the first trustworthy real-site evidence loop before expanding proof presentation, product breadth or protocol scope.

publicJourney.label: Goal / demand
publicJourney.question: Who is this site for, what useful outcome should it create, what demand or intent matters, and what boundaries change the decision?

publicJourney.label: Inspect
publicJourney.question: What does the real public site and source repository actually expose?

publicJourney.label: Decide
publicJourney.question: What is the single highest-value evidence-backed move that actually applies?

publicJourney.label: Change
publicJourney.question: Which exact change can be made safely, deterministically and reviewably?

publicJourney.label: Prove
publicJourney.question: Is that exact intervention really live, and what provider-native evidence followed?

publicJourney.label: Keep / revise / stop
publicJourney.question: What decision is now justified by outcome evidence, drift or changed upstream guidance?

google.primaryAiEvidence: generative-AI Search/Discover impressions and visible-page dimensions from owner Search Console reports

bing.primaryAiEvidence: AI citations, cited pages, grounding queries and provider-native intent/topic/query-scoped citation-share dimensions

openai.primaryAiEvidence: OAI-SearchBot access eligibility plus separately observed ChatGPT referrals or citations when evidence exists

perplexity.primaryAiEvidence: crawler/indexing policy plus bounded observed citations or referrals when evidence exists

keyPrimitive.name: BraidGraph
keyPrimitive.purpose: Versioned evidence-to-change graph linking upstream sources, rule versions, target-site state, repository ownership, recommendations, transformations, verification and outcome evidence.

modules.name: Goose Map
modules.question: What does this site actually have and where is it owned?

modules.name: Goose Patch
modules.question: What can change safely and exactly?

modules.name: Goose Proof
modules.question: Did implementation pass, is the exact intervention live, and what provider-native evidence followed?

modules.name: Goose Watch
modules.question: What needs attention now across the portfolio?

modules.name: Goose Connect
modules.question: What owner/provider evidence exists outside the repository?

durableDifferentiators: one auditable intervention chain instead of a universal readiness or AI visibility score
demand and intent ownership before recommending page or URL expansion
source-backed recommendation supply chain with freshness, supersession and retirement history
exact repository mutation and deployment parity before outcome attribution
provider-native Search and AI evidence kept semantically distinct
neutral and negative experiment outcomes retained rather than filtered out
longitudinal intervention corpus linking site context, recommendation, exact change, deployment, outcome, decision and later rule revision
explicit owner-declared versus publicly observed truth boundaries

productBets.title: Complete the first reviewed real-site intervention using the frozen Ptichi cohort
Make one existing cohort/experiment/receipt chain authoritative for runtime intervention state
Preserve only the provider-native evidence semantics required by active proof cohorts
Render one evidence-derived proof card before any portfolio dashboard
Replicate the same intervention contract on two contrasting owned sites with real owner evidence
One decision-first journey ending in a concise Get Found Brief
Surface Budget and Retirement Gate after proof
Scale portfolio Watch only after the proof success gate

deprioritizedUntilProof: rich Portfolio Proof Board before the first reviewed real-site loop
new top-level public modules without a demonstrated user job
new Resolver, ARD, MCP, WebMCP, transact or cross-lingual protocol breadth without a blocked active proof workflow
stratified State of the Agentic Web expansion as product P0
new Trend or Radar feature breadth beyond maintenance
new transformation-pack breadth without observed blocked target work
new AI-specific markup or files justified only by GEO folklore
indexable URL expansion that has not passed demand, intent and page-value gates
DOI, trust, policy, visual-asset or project-surface count as evidence of discoverability value
new composite readiness or AI visibility scores
